title: Halloween preparation
summary: Preparing the server for Halloween event.
description: We are almost done with polishing details for the upcoming Halloween event.

body.text: The logo and the banner from inside the discord server were changed for decorational purposes.
Added custom plugin & maps to host an event for halloween.
Edited the new discoverable method from Discord.
Removed the new Channel Messages from web presence, while keeping important channels for Channel Summaries.
Created a new custom role for Halloween participants, will be available each year.
